scope:
Original NWN highlight CPU instructions; no renderer, process attach or network.

Executes WritePartHighlightVertices and all reached quaternion/vector/normalize/
finite sqrt instructions against synthetic typed Parts and authored bounds. Also
executes exact Scene Gob-alpha and pulse slices. Pulse uses the original SSE
sinf branch (CPU-feature flag zero), not a replacement Python math routine.
limitations: Synthetic typed Parts/authored bounds and camera; no scene membership/GL draw/real assets.
Leaf executes original math including finite SQRTSS; nonfinite exceptional CRT paths are outside this corpus.
Gob attenuation and pulse execute bounded original Scene slices, not complete DoHighlightGob iteration.
Pulse explicitly selects original SSE sinf CPU branch; actual host AVX/FMA branch is not claimed byte-equivalent.
